## Page 22

2.8 Key Business Highlights
22Positioned in a High -Growth, High -Demand Industry
•FMCG remains a resilient and fast -growing sector .
•We offer essential daily -use products  that consumers consistently need.
•Our products are non -discretionary consumables with recurring demand regardless of economic conditions .
Strong Financial Performance
•Revenue grew over 30% CAGR , from THB 269 million in 2022 to THB 658 million in 2025 .
•Net profit has doubled year -on-year, reaching THB 101 million in 2025  (from THB 13 million in 2022) with NPM over 15%.
•Zero debt  and no external financing from financial institutional. (Low Financial Risk)
•Healthy cash cycle  and strong internal capital management.
Proven Track Record of Product Innovation
•Successfully launched Ver.88  in 2015, establishing brand trust.
•LYO  became an instant consumer favorite since 2022, with successful extensions across anti -hair loss, hair color, and herbal 
products.
•Expanded into skincare with the launch of Hone  in 2022, demonstrating capability to scale beyond core categories.
